# discord_system_channel (Resource)

Manages the system channel settings for a Discord server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID.
- `system_channel_id` (String) The channel ID for system messages (welcome, boost, etc.).

### Optional

- `system_channel_flags` (Number) Bitfield of system channel flags (suppress join notifications = 1, boost = 2, tips = 4, sticker reply = 8).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as server_id.
